items.title: Pearson (LSE:PSON) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Weigh Execution And Upside
items.summary: Pearson’s fair value estimate has been adjusted from £11.83 to about £12.24, reflecting updated assumptions in recent analyst research. This aligns with commentary that acknowledges Pearson’s progress on execution, while also questioning how much upside remains after the share price move and current guidance. items.title: SpaceX at $100 Would Imply Zero AI Value, Morgan Stanley Says
items.summary: (Bloomberg) -- The selloff in SpaceX shares has driven the stock near a level that would imply investors are assigning no value to its artificial intelligence business, according to analysts at Morgan Stanley. items.title: SpaceX Lockup Expiry: Morgan Stanley Believes ‘Largely Unchanged’ Fundamentals Create Attractive Entry Point At Current Levels
